---
title: "2022 Florida Gubernatorial Election in Sarasota County"
author: "Beginning Data Science Student"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

# Load precinct boundary polygons from Sarasota County GIS
precinct_url <- "https://ags3.scgov.net/server/rest/services/Hosted/VotingPrecinct/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1=1&outFields=*&f=geojson"
precincts_sf <- read_sf(precinct_url)

# Load Florida precinct election results
results <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__precinct.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: process-data
# Filter for Sarasota County Governor race and calculate vote shares
sarasota_gov <- results |>
  filter(county == "Sarasota", office == "Governor") |>
  filter(!candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes")) |>
  mutate(precinct = as.integer(precinct)) |>
  group_by(precinct) |>
  summarize(
    total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE),
    desantis_votes = sum(votes[party == "REP"], na.rm = TRUE),
    crist_votes = sum(votes[party == "DEM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    desantis_pct = desantis_votes / total_votes * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Join spatial geometry with election results
sarasota_map_data <- precincts_sf |>
  left_join(sarasota_gov, by = c("precinctnumber" = "precinct"))
```

```{r}
#| label: map
# Plot the precinct-level results
ggplot(sarasota_map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = desantis_pct), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2166ac",
    mid = "white",
    high = "#b2182b",
    midpoint = 50,
    name = "DeSantis %"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2022 Governor Election Results: Sarasota County",
    subtitle = "Precinct-level vote share for Ron DeSantis (REP)",
    caption = "Data: Florida Division of Elections & Sarasota County GIS"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```
